goal: An intentional human stop (AWAITING_APPROVAL, intent=abort, or a budget-ceiling breach) is surfaced into the human-review queue with a reason naming its cause and is never auto-retried, auto-approved, auto-rejected, or otherwise transitioned out of its stop state by the re-driver.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- AWAITING_APPROVAL manual gate (~3521-3542), intent=abort -> FAILED (~2229-2249), budget-ceiling -> FAILED (_finalize_budget_breach ~3806-3851): the three intentional stop sites

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- the approval-resolution sweep (_should_apply_approval ~457) and the loop where these stops are surfaced to the queue WITHOUT being transitioned
references: .flywheel/specs/00069-FEATURE-work-redriver.md -- criteria #10, #11; Decision D-E (human gates are routed, never bypassed)
constraints: ROUTE, NEVER BYPASS: while a lifecycle is AWAITING_APPROVAL its status must stay AWAITING_APPROVAL after re-drive/sweep cycles (no auto-approve, no auto-reject); abort- and budget-terminated runs must not be re-dispatched (criteria #10, #11)
Surface each stop into the queue with a machine-readable reason naming its cause (awaiting-approval / abort / budget-ceiling)
The re-driver must never transition a human/budget stop out of its stop state -- only a human resolves these (D-E)
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under packages/*/tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions
Do not auto-resolve any approval, clear any abort, or raise any budget ceiling
edge_cases: Auto-approving / auto-rejecting an approval gate is the most dangerous failure in this phase and must fail the behavior test
Treating an intentional abort or budget breach as a transient failure to re-drive must fail the behavior test
